notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Axebane Guardian.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.
